items.title: Saving an alert twice creates a duplicate
items.symptom: Clicking Save quickly twice adds the same alert two times to the list.
items.where_contains: does not disable the button while the request is in flight.
items.proposed_fix_contains: reset it in `finally`. The same guard exists
items.how_to_verify: add a vitest case in `AddAlert.spec.ts` that calls submit twice and expects one `create()` call.

items.title: The folder name is cut off
items.where: `web/src/components/alerts/FolderList.vue` → `render`; the label has `overflow: hidden` and no title.
items.proposed_fix: add a `title` binding with the full name.
items.how_to_verify: hover a 100-character folder name and see the full name.
